name: Forest Editorial
tagline: A complete 25-slide editorial system with Instrument Serif, cream and charcoal pages, soft forest photography, team portraits, charts, tables and clear type-led storytelling.

palette.description: Source-matched charcoal and warm cream, with deep green forest photography and neutral black-and-white data graphics.

typography.style: Exact source font families embedded as WOFF2. High-contrast narrow serif display at 140–200 px; restrained Public Sans body at 22–26 px on a 1920 × 1080 canvas.

best_for: Editorial narratives, premium company introductions, brand thinking, nature-inspired proposals and research presentations mixing image, quotation and data.
avoid_for: High-energy neon launches or decks requiring dense dashboard interfaces and technical architecture diagrams.

source_inspiration.name: Pitch Editorial
source_inspiration.notes: Complete 25-page reconstruction of the publicly rendered source using measured native HTML text, shapes, tables and editable SVG chart marks; the source fonts, palette, positioning and original non-person photographic assets are preserved and embedded. Three team portraits are original AI-generated images matched to the reference composition, clothing, lighting and crop; they are not the photographed people. The source video on slide 12 was an unavailable blob and rendered black in the public player; this page retains the original media canvas and captions but supplies an embedded forest photo with a working local pan/pause motion demonstration, static under reduced motion. No source runtime or site UI code is included.
